alanossa.title: Blood Debt
alanossa.intro: A rumor is going around: Alanossa is looking for someone. Not for a job offer.
alanossa.completionMessage: Alanossa is defeated. An era ends. The void keeps this name.

0.title: The Rumor
0.desc: In a bar on The Wreckyard, someone slips you a message. 'Alanossa heard your name. He wants to talk to you. Not in a friendly way.'
0.c0msg: You put the message away. Ignoring Alanossa is a choice.
0.c1msg: You ask around. The answers confirm it: Alanossa wants to settle something. +10 rep (boldness).

1.title: The Messenger
1.desc: One of Alanossa's lieutenants finds you at the dock. 'The boss invites you to West Apocalypse Arc. Alone. Unarmed. These terms aren't negotiable.'
1.c0msg: You accept. The messenger leaves. You head for West Apocalypse Arc.
1.c1msg: Alanossa reluctantly agrees. He respects that. +15 rep.
1.c2msg: You bolt. Alanossa won't forget it. The arc is on hold.

2.title: The Confrontation
2.conditionHint: Alanossa won't receive anyone who hasn't proven themselves — defeat his four lieutenants across the sector first before you can confront, convince, or negotiate with him.
2.desc: You stand before Alanossa. His eyes assess you differently now — you broke four of his lieutenants to get here. 'You have something that belongs to me. Or someone protecting you. Or maybe you're just good. Let's see which of these reasons explains why you're still alive.'
2.c0msg: -3000 cr. Alanossa accepts. Tacit agreement. +30 rep.
2.c2msg: The info interests him. He lets you go with something extra. +50 rep.

raphazarus.title: The Prophet of the Void
raphazarus.intro: The clues finally converge. The Lost Arc isn't a legend — it really drifts somewhere in the Black Nebula. What you're about to find there is like nothing you've been told.
raphazarus.completionMessage: You met Raphazarus at The Lost Arc. The Cult of the Void awaits you — or fears you. Raphazarus can be confronted there if you want to settle this for good.

0.title: The Approach
0.desc: You finally pick up the signal — the real one, not a bar rumor. A station that shouldn't exist, motionless in the dark. The closer you get, the more you understand why no one ever really returns convinced of what they saw.
0.c0msg: The scans say almost nothing. The station absorbs more than it reflects. What you see doesn't match what the instruments measure. +8 rep (caution).
0.c1msg: You don't wait. The Lost Arc grows in your sights, silent, as if it were waiting for you too.

1.title: The First Disciple
1.desc: A woman greets you at the airlock. Dark robe, distant gaze. 'I was told you'd come. Few make it — most abandon the trail before, or never really believe it. Raphazarus is waiting. This is an invitation — not a summons.'
1.c0: Enter — finally see the truth for yourself
1.c0msg: You follow the disciple into the station's depths.
1.c1: Question the disciple — who is Raphazarus, really?
1.c1msg: She barely smiles. 'Everyone wants to know who he is. You'll see. Words aren't enough.' She says nothing more. +5 rep.
1.c2: Hesitate — this is still hard to believe
1.c2msg: 'That's normal,' she says. 'Almost no one believes it before seeing him face to face. He's still waiting for you.'

2.title: Facing Raphazarus
2.conditionHint: Head to The Lost Arc to meet Raphazarus.
2.desc: He's older than you thought. His eyes fix on something behind you. 'The void knows you. I've watched you for a long time. I'm not offering you a job — I'm offering you a purpose.' He waits for your answer.
2.c0: Join the Cult of the Void
2.c0msg: You join the Cult. He places a hand on your shoulder. 'The void has chosen you.' +60 rep. You're now a member of the Cult of the Void.
2.c1: Join the Cult (already committed elsewhere — double allegiance)
2.c1msg: You're playing a dangerous game. Raphazarus accepts — he knows you have other allegiances. Double agent. +30 rep.
2.c2msg: You decline. He doesn't insist. 'The void doesn't forget refusals. But it forgives honesty.' He lets you leave.
2.c3: Negotiate — protection in exchange for information
2.c3msg: A deal is struck. +40 rep, +2000 cr. He owes you something. And you owe him.

vael.title: The Abyss Investigation
vael.intro: A station was destroyed. The Abyss of Velkor. But survivors talk of something else — a disappearance before the disaster.
vael.completionMessage: The truth about Velkor is known. What comes of it is your choice.

0.title: The Survivors
0.desc: At The Abyss of Velkor, an old researcher approaches you. 'Before the incident, someone stole our research. Someone from the inside. I have a name. I need a messenger.'
0.c0msg: You accept. She gives you a name and an address.

1.title: The Trail
1.desc: The name leads to Nexus Aldara. There, the trail goes cold. Someone erased the data. But not well enough.
1.c0: Hack the terminal to recover the data
1.c0msg: [HACKER] Data recovered. +20 rep. You know who.
1.c1msgWin: -400 cr. The info is good. The trail continues.
1.c2: Look for witnesses in the station
1.c2msg: Several testimonies. The truth emerges. +10 rep.

2.title: The Truth
2.desc: The culprit: a research director. He's alive, hidden in the fringes. He's waiting for you — he knew you'd come. 'I did what I had to do. The research would've been destroyed otherwise. I saved it.'
2.c0: Turn him in to the authorities
2.c0msg: Justice served. +50 rep. The researcher pays you.
2.c1: Let him go — maybe he's telling the truth
2.c1msg: He disappears with his research. +20 rep, +1500 cr (his gratitude).
2.c2: Take the research and sell it
2.c2msg: +4000 cr. -20 rep. The data is sold to the highest bidder.

factionwar.title: The Faction War
factionwar.intro: The Black Hawks and the Scarlet Guardians have declared war on each other. The whole sector will feel the consequences.
factionwar.completionMessage: The faction war is over. Your role in it will remain in the archives.

0.title: The Spark
0.desc: An incident at Fort Kharos: a Scarlet Guardian was assassinated. The Black Hawks are accused. Both factions mobilize. Trade routes are cut off.
0.c0msg: You join the Black Hawks. The arc progresses on their side.
0.c1msg: You join the Guardians. The arc progresses on their side.
0.c2msg: You sell information to both sides. +credits. Risky long-term.

1.title: The Battle
1.desc: Both factions clash across the sector. Ships burn. Stations are under blockade. You're asked to pick a side for a decisive mission.
1.c0: Lead the mission (fight your faction's enemy)
1.c0msg: Mission accomplished. +60 rep. The battle turns.
1.c1: Betray and sell the plan to the enemy
1.c1msg: +3000 cr. -40 rep. You're a double agent now.
1.c2: Propose mediation between the two factions
1.c2msg: Both factions listen to you. +100 rep. The war slows down.

2.title: The Resolution
2.desc: The war is coming to an end. A deal is possible — or total victory for one side. You have the power to decide.
2.c0msg: Total victory. +100 rep, +2000 cr. One side dominates now.
2.c1msg: Treaty signed. +150 rep. You're recognized as an architect of peace. Faction leader.
2.c2: Seize control of a faction amid the confusion
2.c2msg: You take the reins. +80 rep, +3000 cr. You're in charge now.
